title: Senior Consultant, Market Intelligence - ERCOT
description:
Customized Energy Solutions (CES) is a global energy services and technology company that helps market participants operate, comply, and compete in deregulated electricity and natural gas markets. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Philadelphia, CES works with utilities, independent power producers, energy suppliers, developers, asset owners, and investors across North America and globally.
CES delivers market intelligence, regulatory and market design support, asset and portfolio management, retail market operations, and energy technology solutions. Our teams track and interpret ISO/RTO rules and policy developments, support resource planning and market participation, manage operational and settlement processes, and develop proprietary software platforms—including CES BLUE, GOLD, RED, GRIDBOOST, and CoMETS—that help clients manage risk, optimize performance, and respond effectively to market change.
CES is committed to advancing transparent, efficient, and non-discriminatory energy markets while delivering practical, high-quality solutions marked by integrity, rigor, and long-term client value.
CES has been nationally and regionally recognized for sustained growth and innovation, including listings on the  Inc. 500|5000  and  Philadelphia Business Journal’s Top 100 Companies , as well as a  Best Places to Work  designation with Hall of Fame status for five or more consecutive years.
With headquarters in Philadelphia and offices across the U.S., Canada, Japan, India, and Vietnam, CES offers a collaborative, flexible, and globally connected work environment for professionals passionate about the future of energy.

Customized Energy Solutions (CES) is a fast-growing and successful energy services and consulting company.  The primary responsibilities for this position are to attend and participate in ERCOT stakeholder meetings and, within days of each meeting, write succinct reports, with analysis where appropriate, on important presentations, announcements, discussions, and other developments from those meetings for internal and external clients.  This position will also require analysis and evaluation of emerging market design proposals.  Qualified candidates for this position will be able to work independently and collaboratively and will possess strong communication and analytical skills. 
Position Responsibilities

- Market IQ service
- Attend and participate in stakeholder meetings and, within days of each meeting, write succinct reports, with analysis where appropriate, on important presentations, announcements, discussions, and other developments from those meetings for internal and external clients.

- As appropriate, tailor reporting and analysis according to clients’ commercial interests ( e.g ., generation, transmission, load, trading) and according to financial, policy, legal, and technical perspectives and considerations.

- Independently identify and define issues according to clients’ commercial interests.

- Recommend appropriate courses of action according to clients’ commercial interests.

- Provide real-time reporting and analysis on developments with immediate and significant commercial impacts on clients.

- Work closely with clients and stay familiar with their interests by addressing clients’ questions in a timely manner and conducting regular (monthly, quarterly) conference calls.

- Consulting and Market Design services
- Attract, engage, and support clients through reports and analysis as well as consulting projects related to existing and emerging market design(s) for ERCOT and other regions.

- Minimum five (5) years energy industry experience required

- Relevant college degree required/graduate degree or advanced industry training preferred

- Wholesale energy market knowledge/experience regarding resource and transmission planning, generation interconnection, resource adequacy, and market design required

- ERCOT and related ISO/RTO knowledge/experience strongly preferred

- Strong writing skills required

- Experience writing under tight deadlines preferred

- Strong analytical/quantitative skills and experience required

- Strong verbal and public presentation skills preferred

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively required

- Business development orientation preferred

Location

- This is a remote work opportunity in the Texas region.

Travel

- Position will require attendance at ERCOT stakeholder meetings and periodic travel to other relevant regional market-related meetings/workshops as well as industry conferences, client/potential client meetings and CES headquarters in Philadelphia.

Customized Energy Solutions India offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience, along with performance-based incentives aligned to individual and company results. Our benefits are designed to support both professional and personal well-being and include comprehensive medical insurance coverage for associates and eligible dependents, generous paid time off, and structured opportunities for professional development through training programs and skill enhancement initiatives. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are supported, challenged, and positioned for long-term career growth.

Customized Energy Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Customized Energy Solutions (CES) is seeking an experienced Analyst, Wholesale Energy Services – Midwest Region to support our wholesale electricity market consulting and operational services, with a primary focus on the MISO market.
The successful candidate will have at least three years of experience in deregulated electricity markets and will work directly with CES wholesale generation and load-serving clients. The role combines day-to-day market operations—including scheduling, settlements, reporting, and other back-office functions—with analytical and consulting work focused on wholesale electricity markets.
This position requires an individual who is analytical, detail-oriented, self-directed, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. The Analyst will work both independently and collaboratively with CES colleagues and clients and will be expected to develop a strong understanding of client operations, MISO market rules, and evolving wholesale market requirements.
Responsibilities

- Coordinate generation scheduling, reporting, and related operational activities for wholesale generation clients.

- Review and analyze MISO settlement statements, identify discrepancies, prepare supporting analyses, and submit settlement disputes when appropriate.

- Develop settlement reports, monitoring tools, models, and other analytical resources to help generation and load-serving clients manage wholesale market activity efficiently.

- Monitor MISO market developments, rule changes, tariff requirements, and settlement impacts and communicate relevant developments to clients.

- Support client operational processes associated with wholesale generation, load, scheduling, settlements, and market participation.

- Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis of MISO wholesale electricity markets and, as needed, other organized electricity markets.

- Develop and enhance analytical and modeling tools used for energy resource assessments, market evaluations, settlement analysis, and related consulting work.

- Participate in research and consulting projects involving wholesale electricity market structures, pricing, generation, load, and market rules.

- Identify potential opportunities to provide scheduling, settlement, analytical, or related wholesale market services to existing and prospective clients.

- Assist in developing proposals and scopes of work and work with clients and prospective clients to refine project objectives and deliverables.

- Communicate analytical findings, market developments, operational issues, and recommendations clearly to internal teams and clients.

- Minimum of three years of professional experience in deregulated or organized wholesale electricity markets.

- Demonstrated knowledge of the MISO wholesale electricity market , including market operations and settlement statements.

- Experience interacting with MISO market systems, processes, or market data.

- Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, economics, mathematics, statistics, finance, or another quantitative or related field.

- Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience conducting market, technical, or project-based research.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify and resolve data or settlement discrepancies.

- Ability to manage recurring operational deadlines while also supporting longer-term analytical projects.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical or market concepts to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working directly with generation owners, load-serving entities, retail energy suppliers, utilities, or other wholesale electricity market participants.

- Experience with MISO scheduling, settlements, market registration, or related operational processes.

- Microsoft SQL or other relational database experience.

- Experience working with large market, settlement, meter, pricing, or operational datasets.

- Experience developing analytical models, reporting tools, or process automation.

- Graduate degree in engineering, economics, statistics, econometrics, mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.

CES offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus a performance bonus, profit-sharing, a Medical Savings Account, comprehensive health insurance, disability and life insurance, 401(k) matching, and tuition reimbursement.
Beyond the package, here’s what you can expect at CES:

- Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact in dynamic energy markets.

- The chance to learn from and collaborate with experienced professionals across global teams.

- Ongoing opportunities to strengthen your technical, analytical, and leadership skills.

- A supportive culture that values initiative, accountability, and continuous professional growth.

Customized Energy Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Customized Energy Solutions is seeking a Renewable Compliance Analyst to provide support on its Renewable Energy Services and Compliance Team, performing a variety of analytical, research based and operational functions. The position will focus on the tracking of regulatory and compliance changes and the management of Client Renewable Energy Credits (RECs). The successful candidate will be a high energy self-starter, a positive proactive team player, highly proficient in Excel and data analysis, and possess excellent communication skills and initiative. The position will require direct interaction with Clients and regulatory authorities. Must be able to work independently and as part of a team. Being detail oriented and a person of integrity are essential qualities, as is an ability to handle new tasks and manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
Representative Duties
 

- Track Renewable Energy Credit (REC) markets and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) regulatory changes.

- Monitor state and utility regulatory proceedings to identify relevant developments/rule changes and provide relevant actionable items to business team and/or clients.

- Maintenance and management of complex data sets, models, and information tracking systems for additional data and tracking systems as needed.

- Maintain and manage the processes for tracking required RTO, state, and utility compliance filings for retail suppliers, including the maintenance of a comprehensive accounting of requirements, data collection and timely notification system.

- Manage ongoing renewable generation and retail energy compliance REC portfolios using CES’ proprietary platform.

- Support the process to prepare and submit registrations and ongoing federal, ISO, state and utility reports.

- Establish and maintain strong relationships with clients, counterparties, and regulatory authorities.

- Perform other duties as assigned/needed.

- Relevant undergraduate degree required.

- 2+ years relevant work experience.

- Energy industry background preferred with experience in Compliance or RPS obligations and REC markets, particularly PJM and ISO-NE.

- Excellent analytic processing skills.

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to work well in a deadline-driven, self-managed environment.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

- Demonstrated ability to think “outside the box” by developing and implementing improvements to processes and tools.

CES offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus a performance bonus, profit-sharing, a Medical Savings Account, comprehensive health insurance, disability and life insurance, 401(k) matching, and tuition reimbursement.

Customized Energy Solutions (CES) is seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator to support and manage the organization's enterprise database environments across on-premises and cloud infrastructure. This position is based in Ho Chi Minh City and may allow limited hybrid flexibility depending on business needs.
Key Responsibilities
Database Administration & Infrastructure

- Administer, configure, monitor, and support enterprise database environments across on-premises and cloud infrastructure

- Support installation, upgrades, patching, migrations, backup/recovery, and ongoing maintenance of database systems

- Manage and support SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or similar relational database platforms

- Maintain database standards, operational procedures, and environment documentation

Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting

- Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, and troubleshooting

- Investigate and resolve database-related incidents, failures, and operational issues

- Support proactive monitoring and alerting processes

- Partner with infrastructure and security teams to maintain compliance and operational standards

Cloud & Data Platform Support

- Support cloud-based database services and integrations across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments

- Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams supporting reporting, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data platform initiatives

- Partner with application teams to improve database design, scalability, and operational efficiency

- Participate in infrastructure modernization and automation initiatives

- Contribute to documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-sharing activities

- Stay current on database technologies, cloud platforms, and operational best practices

- Minimum 5–8 years of database administration experience supporting enterprise production environments

- Strong hands-on experience with one or more major database platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle

- Experience with database performance tuning, troubleshooting, backup/recovery, and high availability solutions

- Experience supporting cloud platforms and cloud-based database services within AWS, Azure, or GCP environments

- Exposure to modern analytics platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, or similar technologies preferred
